summary: Controls the intensity of the synthetic light applied by Stability's replace-background-and-relight edit operation. Higher values make the selected light source affect the subject and scene more strongly.
combines: Supported only by `edit/replace-background-and-relight` and requires an input image for the operation.
It is meaningful only with a light-source direction or a light-reference image that defines the source being strengthened.
Background replacement, original-background depth, and source-light settings jointly determine the result; Lixpi does not expose this unimplemented operation as independent controls.
note: Separate asynchronous Replace Background and Relight feature; not implemented in this iteration.
